journals.observation: Koka woke up cheerful. Enjoyed his morning Doi-Chira in the ancestral brass bowl and pointed at the Kopou orchid blooming on the veranda.

deEscalationApplied.actionTaken: Sat together naming orchids and humming a morning Borgeet.

aiCouncilAnalysis.clinicalInsight: High orientation and positive affect stimulated by tactile heirloom object.
aiCouncilAnalysis.empathySuggestion: Continue reinforcing morning routine with authentic tea ritual.
aiCouncilAnalysis.factVerificationNote: Verified: Brass bowl is confirmed wedding gift from 1968.
aiCouncilAnalysis.recommendedNextStep: Present Level 1 Photo Recall game during peak morning alertness.

journals.observation: Around 5:45 PM as dusk settled, Koka looked around restlessly and asked where his briefcase was, saying the tea factory bell was about to ring.

deEscalationApplied.actionTaken: Deepak gently affirmed: "Your work at the tea estate is completed with honors, Koka. Everything is safe." Turned on warm yellow lamps and played soft flute music.

aiCouncilAnalysis.clinicalInsight: Circadian sundowning triggered by dimming natural light. Excellent non-pharmacological response by son.
aiCouncilAnalysis.empathySuggestion: Never contradict or say "You retired 18 years ago". Reassure safety and sense of accomplishment.
aiCouncilAnalysis.factVerificationNote: Verified: Bhaben retired as Senior Superintendent in 2008.
aiCouncilAnalysis.recommendedNextStep: Ensure ambient warm lighting is turned on automatically at 5:00 PM.

nodes.label: Bhaben Baruah (Koka)
nodes.details: Age 76, retired tea executive from Assam Tea Corp in Jorhat. Now resides in Beltola, Guwahati.

nodes.details: Manages tea estates in Golaghat. Primary family caregiver. Brings fresh first-flush orthodox tea weekly.

nodes.details: School teacher in Bangalore. Visits for Magh Bihu every winter to make Til Pitha and Narikol Laru with Koka.

nodes.details: College student in Guwahati. Plays the Bihu dhol at Latasil playground with a bright red Phulam Gamusa.

heirlooms.name: 1968 Ancestral Brass Kahi-Bati
heirlooms.tactileDescription: Heavy bell-metal brass, cool to the touch with soft carved floral borders along the rim.
heirlooms.memoryStory: Gifted to Bhaben Koka and Pratibha Aita on their wedding day in Sivasagar in 1968 by Koka’s grandmother. For over 50 years, Koka has enjoyed fresh Doi-Chira and golden molasses from this very bowl.

provenanceVerification.verificationLevel: Physical Heirloom on Dining Shelf, Guwahati

heirlooms.name: Handwoven Red Phulam Gamusa
heirlooms.vernacularName: ৰঙা ফুলম গামোচা (Handloom Cotton Towel of Honor)
heirlooms.tactileDescription: Crisp hand-spun white cotton with raised red hand-embroidered floral motifs (kalka & orchids).
heirlooms.memoryStory: Presented to Koka during the 1974 Bohag Bihu celebration in Jorhat when he organized the community Bihu husori. He always holds it gently across his shoulders when listening to Bihu dhol beats.

heirlooms.name: 1980 Vintage Philips Wooden Valve Radio
heirlooms.tactileDescription: Polished teakwood casing with amber tuning dial and warm mechanical rotary knobs.
heirlooms.memoryStory: Bought with his first managerial bonus at the Cinnamara tea estate in 1980. Every evening at 7:00 PM, the whole family would gather on the veranda to listen to AIR Guwahati news and Borgeet melodies.

heirlooms.name: 1982 Parker 51 Golden Nib Fountain Pen
heirlooms.tactileDescription: Smooth black resin body with a 14k brushed golden cap and fine arrow clip.
heirlooms.memoryStory: Used by Koka to sign tea quality tasting reports and write heartfelt letters to Deepak when Deepak was studying in Guwahati. Koka always kept it in his top shirt pocket.

posts.message: Koka, sending you so much love from Bangalore! Look at this photo from last Magh Bihu when we rolled warm Til Pitha together on the veranda. I cannot wait to be back in Guwahati this winter! Take your morning tea peacefully.
posts.caregiverNotes: Verified video call snippet. Safe and deeply comforting for Koka.

posts.message: Koka! I practiced the 3-beat rhythm you taught me on the Bihu dhol today. Everyone at college cheered! Tomorrow morning after your stroll I will come play it live for you on the cane mora.
Deuta, Deepak and I packed the finest first-flush golden tips orthodox tea from the estate today. He is driving back to Guwahati tomorrow with the fresh batch for your 4 PM tea!
